The Scaffold Handshake

[SLIDE: The Page API Scaffold]

[NARRATIVE: Welcome to your first day as a Moodle Architect. Before we bring in the data, we must build the scaffold. The Page API is that blueprint.]

The Database Handshake

[SLIDE: DML API - The Fuel]

[NARRATIVE: Every scaffold needs material. The DML API fetches that material—user records, grades, and logs—safely and efficiently.]

The Path Handshake

[SLIDE: Navigation API Architecture]

[NARRATIVE: Without a compass, the user is lost. The Navigation API ensures they always know where they are in your plugin.]

The Visual Handshake

[SLIDE: The Output API Engine]

[NARRATIVE: If the Page API is the skeleton, the Output API is the skin. It renders your logic into beautiful, accessible templates.]

The Input Handshake

[SLIDE: The Form API Entry]

[NARRATIVE: Security starts at the front door. The Form API acts as an air-lock for all user data entering your system.]

The Security Air-Lock

[SLIDE: Form API Security Layers]

[NARRATIVE: We never trust user input. We use the Form API to validate and sanitize every field before it touches the database.]

The Motion Sensor

[SLIDE: The Events API Overview]

[NARRATIVE: Think of the Events API as a motion sensor. It broadcasts signals whenever a user interacts with the system.]

The Notification Handshake

[SLIDE: Observing System Events]

[NARRATIVE: By observing events, your plugin can react to actions across all of Moodle without changing a single line of core code.]

The Scribe

[SLIDE: Logging API Records]

[NARRATIVE: The Logging API records events for posterity. This is where our AI Miner finds the raw data to generate reports.]

The Automation Handshake

[SLIDE: The Task API Background Robot]

[NARRATIVE: Heavy lifting belongs in the background. The Task API manages long-running processes without slowing down the user's screen.]

The Translator

[SLIDE: String API Multilingual]

[NARRATIVE: In a global classroom, hard-coding text is a cardinal sin. The String API fetches the correct translation based on user settings.]

The Bouncer

[SLIDE: The Access API Permissions]

[NARRATIVE: The Access API is your digital guard. It checks capabilities to ensure users only see and do what they are allowed.]

The Gateway

[SLIDE: Enrolment API Gateway]

[NARRATIVE: The Enrolment API controls the gateway to learning, managing how users are assigned to and removed from courses.]

The Scorekeeper

[SLIDE: Gradebook API Architecture]

[NARRATIVE: Success must be measured. The Gradebook API allows plugins to push scores into Moodle's central grading system.]

The Predictor

[SLIDE: Analytics API Brain]

[NARRATIVE: The Analytics API uses machine learning to predict student outcomes and flag at-risk learners before they fail.]

Performance Handshake

[SLIDE: Moodle Universal Cache MUC]

[NARRATIVE: Speed is a feature. The Cache API reduces database load by storing frequently used data in memory.]

[SLIDE: Cache Implementation Code]

[NARRATIVE: We initialize the cache with a single line of code, allowing for lightning-fast data retrieval across sessions.]

[SLIDE: Cache Laboratory Exercise]

[NARRATIVE: Now it is your turn. Your task is to define a custom cache store for a high-traffic plugin.]

GDPR Compliance

[SLIDE: Privacy API Overview]

[NARRATIVE: Trust is essential. The Privacy API ensures your plugin respects data protection laws like GDPR by default.]

[SLIDE: Privacy Providers Demo]

[NARRATIVE: By implementing a Privacy Provider, you allow users to export or delete their data with a single click.]

[SLIDE: Privacy Laboratory Exercise]

[NARRATIVE: Map out the user data your plugin stores and ensure it is covered by the Privacy API handshake.]

Cloud Connectivity

[SLIDE: Repository API Cloud]

[NARRATIVE: The Repository API connects Moodle to the world, allowing users to pull files from OneDrive or Google Drive.]

[SLIDE: File Picker Interface Demo]

[NARRATIVE: Witness how the file picker provides a unified interface for every external storage provider.]

[SLIDE: Repository Laboratory Exercise]

[NARRATIVE: Build a function that fetches a remote file and attaches it to a Moodle course resource.]

The Bridge Handshake

[SLIDE: External API REST Bridge]

[NARRATIVE: The External API is our bridge to the outside world, enabling secure REST and SOAP mobile connections.]
